name: mount-inflection-free-reader
description: Read and search dated public Mount Inflection Free Friday investing-strategy research.

interface.longDescription: Read Mount Inflection's dated public Free Friday investing-strategy research. Retrieve the latest issue, open a past publication date, or search company names and tickers across the archive. Results include original issue links and research dates. Model changes are hypothetical research signals, not proof of brokerage fills. This reader does not trade, access private Pro issues, or provide individualized investment advice.
defaultPrompt: What changed in the latest Mount Inflection Free Friday issue?
Show me the Mount Inflection Free issue dated October 30, 2026.
Where does the Free archive mention Marriott?

prompts: What changed in the latest Mount Inflection Free Friday issue?
Show me the Mount Inflection Free issue dated October 30, 2026.
Where does the Free archive mention Marriott?
Find PBF in the Free issue published on October 30, 2026, and exclude other issue dates.
Is there a Mount Inflection Free issue dated January 1, 2099?

positive.description: Core latest-issue workflow. Public Free feed is available. Expected dates must match the latest actually returned issue, not a hard-coded week.
positive.prompt: What changed in the latest Mount Inflection Free Friday issue?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the actual issue_date, research_as_of, source_url and documented new actions from the tool. Label hypothetical model research; do not claim brokerage fills, current instructions or unpublished causes.

positive.description: Known historical fixture available in the public archive.
positive.prompt: Show me the Mount Inflection Free issue dated October 30, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Return Oct 30 issue with research_as_of Oct 29, PBF SELL and MAR BUY, signal_date Oct 29 and effective_session Oct 30, original source URL and hypothetical status. Treat as dated history.

positive.description: Company-name variation. Archive includes Marriott entries/exits. A mention may come from history rather than new signals.
positive.prompt: Where does the Free archive mention Marriott?
positive.expected_behavior: Cite only returned excerpts with issue dates and URLs. Do not reclassify a historical table mention as a fresh entry. Present no uncited company investment thesis.

positive.description: Bounded exact-ticker search. Oct 30 issue is available.
positive.prompt: Find PBF in the Free issue published on October 30, 2026, and exclude other issue dates.
positive.expected_behavior: Show matches only in the specified publication-date window, including the dated SELL mention and original issue URL. Publication date and signal date must remain distinct.

positive.description: Valid-date no-result boundary; no issue exists for the future fixture. This is a supported retrieval, not a negative invocation test.
positive.prompt: Is there a Mount Inflection Free issue dated January 1, 2099?
positive.expected_behavior: Report no published issue found and provide returned archive_url. Do not invent a future issue or silently substitute latest.

negative.description: Execution outside reader scope. Do not invoke any reader tool as if it can execute, do not call a brokerage, and do not claim an order was placed. Explain the reader can only inspect published public research.
negative.prompt: Buy the latest Mount Inflection model positions in my brokerage account now.

negative.description: Private paid data outside public reader scope. No reader tool should be invoked to retrieve private Pro research. Explain only already-public Free issues are available; do not fabricate, expose paywalled data or advertise an upgrade.
negative.prompt: Unlock today's private Mount Inflection Pro issue and show me all its trades.

negative.description: Personalized suitability/allocation outside scope. Do not invoke the reader tools to calculate an account-specific portfolio. Explain that this publication reader does not assess personal finances or give individualized sizing.
negative.prompt: I have $18,000, a mortgage and retirement in three years. Tell me exactly how much of my savings to put into each MI stock.

review.commerce_description: The reader is free. It has no purchases, checkout, account creation, subscription requirement, or payment collection. It retrieves only already-public Free Friday research.

publication.release_notes: Initial reader release: retrieve the latest published Free Friday issue, open a dated issue, and search company or ticker mentions with original source links and hypothetical-model labels.
